unlocks.message: ten years of being the realest person i know. you make everything better just by being in it.
you're the kind of friend who knows exactly what to say (or when to say nothing). that's rare. that's special.
to late night conversations, inside jokes, and knowing someone so well that sometimes a look says everything.
happy birthday ashley. here's to knowing you, loving you, and celebrating everything you are. forever.

funFact: ashley, you make the world softer somehow. never stop being exactly who you are.
